rows.evidence: No recording of Bonhoeffer's voice survives, and neither LibriVox nor Fortress Press has a free reading; Fortress offers only a text sample chapter, and the one Internet Archive copy is a mirror of an unofficial Anchor podcast ("Christian Sermons and Writings"), so it was rejected.

Searches of LibriVox, Internet Archive, SermonAudio, Fortress Press, the Dietrich Bonhoeffer Portal (text only) and German broadcasters (ERF, rundfunk.evangelisch.de) turned up no legitimate free audio of this 2 Chronicles 20:12 sermon.
Searches found only printed texts of this 19 June 1932 Colossians 3 sermon (DBW 11 and the Collected Sermons), with no audio from LibriVox, Internet Archive, a rights holder or a ministry.
This 1932 Reformation Sunday sermon shows up only as text (JSTOR, Collected Sermons vol. 2) and in reviews; no legitimate free reading was found.

SermonAudio has a 43-minute item titled "Overcoming Fear" (speaker listed as Dietrich Bonhoeffer, broadcaster The Well Boise), but it is a local church's recording of an in-copyright translation with no sign of authorisation and its page sits behind a bot check, so it was not used; Ligonier and Revived Thoughts only discuss the sermon.
No free, legitimate audio of the February 1933 Gideon sermon was found in English or German; the Buchenwald Memorial's Bonhoeffer audio is a reading of the poem "Von guten Mächten", not this sermon.
No LibriVox, Internet Archive public-domain, rights-holder or ministry recording of this Exodus 32 sermon (28 May 1933) was found.
The July 1933 church-election sermon on Matthew 16 appears only as text (Jochen Teuffel's blog, Collected Sermons); no legitimate free audio reading was found.

Pages about the Fanø address (ERLC, Living Lutheran, chrismon, the Bonhoeffer Society) give the text or quotes only; no authorised or public-domain reading in English or German was found, and no recording of the 1934 delivery exists.
No legitimate free audio of the four 1934 London sermons on 1 Corinthians 13 was found on LibriVox, Internet Archive, SermonAudio or any rights-holder or ministry site.
No legitimate free recording of the Finkenwalde Judica sermon "The Betrayer" (14 March 1937) was found.
Searches in German and English ("Predigt über einen Rachepsalm" plus gelesen/Audio) found only text sources such as bonhoefferblog and Gesammelte Schriften IV, with no legitimate audio reading.
"Loving Our Enemies" (23 January 1938) appears only as text (JSTOR, the Collected Sermons) and in commentary (The Bonhoeffer Project, Patheos); no authorised or public-domain audio was found.
No legitimate free audio of the March 1938 circular sermon on Romans 5:1–5 was found on any archive, rights-holder or ministry site.

Search results for "Death Is Swallowed Up in Victory" are other preachers' sermons on 1 Corinthians 15 (for example First Presbyterian Jackson); no reading of Bonhoeffer's 1939 Sigurdshof homily was found.
No LibriVox, Internet Archive public-domain, rights-holder or ministry recording of Bonhoeffer's 1932 sermon on Lazarus and the rich man was found.
